# apicurio_role_mapping (Resource)

The registry role of a principal, on a registry that manages roles itself: `apicurio.auth.role-based-authorization=true` and `apicurio.auth.role-source=application`. Without that, every role mapping request is refused (HTTP 403) and the provider reports it. The principal is the `preferred_username` claim of a user or the name of a service account (`service-account-<client id>`), as the registry sees it in `apicurio_current_user`. A principal without a mapping can read nothing and write nothing; the server's admin override (`apicurio.auth.admin-override.enabled`) is how the first admin, usually the provider's own credentials, gets in. Needs the admin role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Roles on a registry with apicurio.auth.role-based-authorization=true and
# apicurio.auth.role-source=application. The principal is the preferred
# username of a user or the name of a service account.
resource "apicurio_role_mapping" "ci" {
  principal_id   = "service-account-ci-pipeline"
  role           = "DEVELOPER"
  principal_name = "CI pipeline"
}

resource "apicurio_role_mapping" "auditors" {
  principal_id = "auditor"
  role         = "READ_ONLY"
}

# Who the provider itself is, as the registry sees it.
data "apicurio_current_user" "me" {}

output "provider_is_admin" {
  value = data.apicurio_current_user.me.admin
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) User or service account id as the token names it. Changing it replaces the mapping.
- `role` (String) `READ_ONLY`, `DEVELOPER` or `ADMIN`. Changed in place.

### Optional

- `principal_name` (String) Display name stored with the mapping. The registry cannot change it, so a change replaces the mapping.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The principal id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role mappings are imported by principal id.
terraform import apicurio_role_mapping.ci service-account-ci-pipeline
```
